title: Reject one positive short-cluster representation without claiming sampling hardness
statement: For one sufficiently large fixed rational g at eta=0, compile the supplied constant-depth NN2D Clifford/Bell-localization construction with finite-duration Pauli Hamiltonians, prechosen random Pauli dressing and the replacement bath active through gates/idles. The ideal reference has local-stochastic wire parameter O(g^-1/2); rational pulse approximation preserves a corrected Bell fidelity>0.9 with O(log N+log(1/nu)) timing bits. Any positive quantum-cluster decomposition then needs spanning-cluster probability>0.8 since F<=1/2+theta/2. This excludes a uniformly exponentially short-cluster representation, not a classical latent sampler or robust TV-hardness.
